title: Store the AI model setting in the real core

proofs.pass: selftest slice aikey: model all pass, 9 broken models each red on its own cases.*the seam probe finds the seam and misses it when absent

notes: The mutant makes model_for accept a key in any state (ai_settings.rs:504); its red line is the existing usable-state test. The Keychain half is the secrets crate (core/crates/secrets/tests/keychain.rs, memory.rs); the rig keeps the key in a memory keychain (engine_ai_settings.rs header). 'the draft engine and the label AI read it': ai_settings::model_for(&store, &keyring, AiJob::Draft) is what both call (engine_ai_settings.rs:299, :418). gap-engine-state: engine_ai_draft.rs prints `PASS key-saved-then-draft-written-by-the-provider (N completion request(s))` and `PASS draft-refused-while-the-key-is-checked-then-allowed` (-- --nocapture). Not compiled in this lane (no cargo run allowed): the lead's first run decides; the draft text assertion assumes the draft engine stores the trimmed provider text (write_draft.rs:110). (tail-realcore, 2026-11-12) the installed-shape half is built: checks/realcore-check.py `--slice-aikey` (drive_aikey, judge_aikey, main_slice_aikey) starts checks/realcore_aifake.py on 127.0.0.1, launches the hidden copy with WHOOSH_CORE_CHECK_PROVIDERS=<its port> (rig.rs routes the key providers' hosts there) and reads the build's executables for that literal first: a build without it prints NOT JUDGED and launches nothing (a pasted key would reach the real provider). The app part: add the local account (one mail), open the thread and the quick reply (Enter, R), press ⌘J with no key (the field must say `failed` in words, no draft), open Settings by `mac-palette.result.ai-settings`, click `mac-settings-ai.provider.anthropic.key`, type the fake's made-up key (never printed), click `.connect`, read the card (`connected`, models listed, `core state provider_credential/anthropic/stored` true), go back, press ⌘J again and read `reply/draft/<thread>` (the text the fake answered: `A reply from <model>.`) and the reply field. The fake provider's own record must show an accepted completion. The doors are the ones checks/firstrun-check.py (T-13) and checks/parity/par-quickreply.py already drive; none was run on this build, so a NOT JUDGED or FAIL on a door is the first finding to read (the Writer model is not picked: the engine test needed none). The broken copies are the two edits above (the `--mutant` flag of the other slices does not exist here: no engine name hooks them). Written and self-tested, not run on a bundle.
